name: No Big Deal
desc:
// This is the under 18 version. If you are +18, please join here instead: https://www.roblox.com/games/92939399319021/No-Big-Deal

💾 Round based business-negotiation shooter. Cooperate with your coworkers to attempt to raise the most capital through deals, ambushes, negotiations, and trying not to shoot anyone. 

⚠️This game can be highly confusing for those uninitiated. It is recommended to watch gameplay or study a tutorial before jumping in.

🎤 Voice Chat is recommended to join. You won't have to talk, but you will want to be able to hear others.

All animations are fully procedural. All roleplay is highly encouraged.

Blatant ripoff of Sub Rosa, Doldin's Pillar and Custer's Quest For Gold 2: The Isle of Hate
